title: Mollification: a continuous compactly supported covector field is a uniform limit of test forms
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let h : ℝ^P → Λⁿ(ℝ^P) (Covector (Euclid P) n) be continuous with compact support. Then there is a sequence (ω_j)_{j∈ℕ} of test forms ω_j ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) (TestFormOn univ n: C^∞ with compact support) converging to h uniformly on ℝ^P (TendstoUniformly, for the operator norm on Λⁿ(ℝ^P)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (h : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n), Continuous h → HasCompactSupport h → ∃ ωs : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, TendstoUniformly (fun j x => (ωs j : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) h atTop
